calibration_policy: benign only from a second environment; direct threshold at 1% calibration FPR and review threshold at 5%
limitations: Class sampling and exact-vector deduplication prevent representative false-alerts-per-hour estimates.
Anomaly results are not classifier probabilities; ECE and Brier are not applicable.
This experiment does not include temporal Schema B or signature evidence.
